meta.name: background-removal
meta.description: Remove backgrounds from images with BiRefNet via inference.sh CLI. Model: BiRefNet (high accuracy background removal). Use for: product photos, portraits, e-commerce, transparent PNGs, photo editing. Triggers: remove background, background removal, remove bg, transparent background, cut out image, background remover, rembg, product photo editing, cutout, transparent png, bg removal, photo cutout

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除图片背景,生成透明 PNG
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常处理产品图或人像,需要快速抠出背景
copy.tagline_en: Remove image backgrounds and export transparent PNGs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often edit product or portrait photos and need quick background removal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 inference.sh 命令行调用 BiRefNet 模型去除图片背景，或使用 Reve 模型编辑背景，最终输出透明背景的 PNG 图片。需要预先安装 infsh 工具。
howto.when: 当用户提出去除背景、透明背景、抠图等需求，或要求处理产品照片、人像、电商图片时触发。常见触发词如“remove background”、“remove bg”、“透明背景”等。

say.text: 把这张商品图的背景去掉
say.note: 将调用 BiRefNet 生成透明背景 PNG。

say.text: 把这照片的背景换成海滩
say.note: 将用 Reve 编辑器修改背景。

say.text: 生成一个机器人吉祥物，再抠掉背景
say.note: 先作图再用 Reve 编辑，得到透明 PNG。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the inference.sh CLI to remove image backgrounds with BiRefNet, or edit backgrounds with Reve, outputting transparent-background PNGs. Requires the infsh CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to remove backgrounds, create transparent images, cut out subjects, or edit product/portrait photos. Keywords include 'remove background', 'remove bg', etc.

say_en.text: Remove the background from this product photo.
say_en.note: Calls BiRefNet to produce a transparent PNG.

say_en.text: Change this photo's background to a beach.
say_en.note: Uses Reve to edit the background.

say_en.text: Generate a robot mascot, then cut out its background.
say_en.note: Generates then edits with Reve for a transparent PNG.
